|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>I would make a chemistry joke, but I'm afraid I wouldn't get a reaction.

==Transportation==
*Teleport to Ardougne, charter Captain Barnaby to Rimmington
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in Rimmington, or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Rimmington [[house portal]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] teleport to the [[Air Altar]].
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Crafting Guild]].
*[[Crafting cape]] teleport to the [[Crafting Guild]].
*[[Balloon transport system]] to the [[Crafting Guild]].
*[[Charter ship]] to [[Port Sarim]].
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|aiq}}.
*[[Falador Teleport]] and run south to Rimmington.
